title: Elixir of Cold Resistance

sources.title: Elixir of Cold Resistance
markers: * Consume the elixir to gain [[resistance]] to {{DamageType|Cold}} damage.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain resistance to Cold damage until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain resistance to Cold damage until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one bottle. Applies the listed protection to creatures within 3 ft of impact. The item source does not give a separate thrown duration. Replaces existing elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
